p1.caption: P1: the sweep's error against its own correct target (the span mean) is a quadrature error, ~8 orders of magnitude below its error against the point value. The `lam`+1% control breaks the identity. Bars are medians over the cells each report owns.

p2.caption: P2: the interior MSE-optimal span `h*(sigma)` on log-log axes, for every arm of both systems. The slopes cluster by REPRESENTATION -- ~1/3 for the smooth arms of both systems, ~0.41 for the delivered C0 arms of both -- and the dotted line is the derived `sigma^{1/3}` reference.

p3.caption: P3: identification error by the price-only prediction. Left: full range and median per class on a log scale -- predicted-interior cells sit below the resolution, predicted-pinned cells do not. Right: the soundness count, no predicted-interior cell above `1e-2`.

p4.caption: P4: what separates the routes is access, not the object. (a) median `r` of each route against the true curve -- the moments LEVEL reading is the same object, the PROFILE reading has the wrong sign on every defined cell. (b) the system-identification route's reconstruction quality rising with the log length.
